observations.explanation: The approved in vivo LNP experiment includes the NSGHAsgRNA/Cas9 mRNA MC3-LNP arm, but its support spans the gene-editing results clauses as well as the treatment clauses. Relevant in-scope clauses were retained and unrelated formulation-optimization and hydrodynamic-plasmid experiments were excluded from experiment-specific claims.

evidence.quote: The NSGHAsgRNA was encapsulated with Cas9 mRNA into MC3 LNP and intravenously injected into NSG HemA mice at a dosage of 4 mg/kg of Cas9/sgRNA LNP.
NGS sequencing analysis revealed an approximately 16.5% deletion frequency in LSECs following Cas9/sgRNA LNP treatment.

observations.explanation: Component-role claims used an lnp_component as both the subject and object of has_component_role. The contract provides no entity type for a component-role object, so these claims were removed.

evidence.quote: ionizable cationic lipids, specifically MC3
We incorporated the helper lipid DOPE and DMG-PEG2000 into MC3 LNP formulation

observations.explanation: An editing endpoint is not a therapeutic intervention and cannot have therapeutic_target_cell as a valid relation. LSEC-specific editing is instead represented as an endpoint with cell-specific reported name and outcome.
